## About

We work on making highly accurate many-electron correlation methods computationally affordable for materials and large molecular complexes. 
We focus primarily on plane-wave based approaches, coupled cluster methods, and embedding techniques. 

The drive behind our group is practical: we want to create workflows and software tools that researches actually use.
We apply our tools to study complex materials, compute high-accuracy reference databases to train AI models, and spend a lot of our time developing and maintaining software for the broader quantum chemistry and materials physics communities.
